  (: is-variable 
    (-> Atom Bool))
  (= 
    (is-variable $x) 
    (== 
      (get-metatype $x) Variable))
  (: lazy-or 
    (-> Bool Atom Bool))
  (= 
    (lazy-or False $x) $x)
  (= 
    (lazy-or True $x) True)
  (: is-expression 
    (-> Atom Bool))
  (= 
    (is-expression $x) 
    (== 
      (get-metatype $x) Expression))
  (: is-closed 
    (-> Atom Bool))
  (= 
    (is-closed $x) 
    (if 
      (is-variable $x) False 
      (if 
        (is-expression $x) 
        (lazy-or 
          (let $head 
            (car-atom $x) 
            (is-closed $head)) 
          (let $tail 
            (cdr-atom $x) 
            (is-closed $tail))) True)))

;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
;;;; DTL Backward chaining Curried ;;
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
;;;; Base case
  (: bc 
    (-> $a Nat $a))
  (= 
    (bc 
      (: $prf $ccln) $) 
    (match &kb 
      (: $prf $ccln) 
      (: $prf $ccln)))
;;;; Recursive step
  (= 
    (bc 
      (: 
        ($prfabs $prfarg) $ccln) 
      (S $k)) 
    (let* 
      ( ( (: $prfabs 
            (-> $prms $ccln)) (bc (: $prfabs (-> $prms $ccln)) $k)) ((: $prfarg $prms) (bc (: $prfarg $prms) $k))) 
      (: 
        ($prfabs $prfarg) $ccln)))
;;;; System proof for ⍃
;;;; if conclusion equals (⍃ $X $Y), then return (: CPU (⍃ $X $Y)) 
;;;; if $x and $Y are fully grounded and (< $X $Y)
  (= 
    (bc 
      (: CPU 
        (⍃ $X $Y)) $) 
    (if 
      (and 
        (and 
          (is-closed $X) 
          (is-closed $Y)) 
        (< $X $Y)) 
      (: CPU 
        (⍃ $X $Y)) 
      (empty)))
;;;; System proof for isDiff
  (= 
    (bc 
      (: CPUDiff 
        (isDiff $X $Y)) $) 
    (if 
      (and 
        (and 
          (is-closed $X) 
          (is-closed $Y)) 
        (== $X $Y)) 
      (empty) 
      (: CPUDiff 
        (isDiff $X $Y))))
